newsitem.title: ESTONIA: NEW EXCISE TAX TO COME INTO FORCE - NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: NEW EXCISE TAX TO COME INTO FORCE - NEWSPAPER.

text.p: The government has not considered a postponement to the imposition of a new beer excise tax that will affect Saku brewery from July 1, Aripaev newspaper said on Friday.
Because the government has not considered the proposal, the new, higher rates will come into force from July 1, the business newspaper said.
The proposed delay was presented by the finance and economic ministries and sought to hold off for six months the imposition of the excise on the largest local producer in the country.
The excise rise was decided by parlimant in April.
